answer_2.quote: We compare DI‑DAN to several baselines, evaluating performance based on how often an article was correctly labeled.

answer_4.quote: Qualified Amazon Mechanical Turk workers with required English proficiency are used in all of our experiments. Workers are asked to evaluate the article based on its style, content, consistency and overall trustworthiness.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rate articles on style, content, consistency between text and images, and overall trustworthiness using a four‑point scale.
